name: Upper Connecticut River Mitigation and Enhancement Fund
summary: Grants for restoring, protecting and enhancing the Connecticut River, its wetlands and shorelands upstream of White River Junction, funded from a hydroelectric relicensing settlement. Tax-exempt nonprofits and municipalities apply after talking to staff.

geography.label: Upper Connecticut River watershed (NH and VT)

reporting: A final grant report with a final metrics form is due at the end of the funding period; applicants must also file interim or final reports on all outstanding projects before applying again.

status.quote: This fund is not accepting applications at this time.

applicant_types.quote: Must be recognized as tax-exempt under Section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code, or be a municipality or other subdivision of government.

geography.quote: Funding is limited to the Connecticut River watershed upstream of the confluence of the White River and the Connecticut River at White River Junction, VT and West Lebanon, NH.

reporting.quote: At the end of your funding period, complete and submit a final grant report (including a final metrics form reflecting actual project accomplishments).
